# Recursive enum tokens with opaque Boolean results

An invariant Class<E> token retains the method-owned Enum<E> bound beside a
closed String context. Original calls, callback writes, exact input identities,
Boolean values and failures remain intact. Null, raw non-enum and primitive
tokens do not acquire validation or enum initialization. Four frozen invocation
paths run 192 fresh cases twice, including input casts and negated consumers.
Fifteen wrong programs and eight same-Code Signature controls qualify the
observers. Source and SDK paths compile every emitted source and check original
definitions, roles, Signature and Exceptions attributes.
